subject: Onboarding: Starlite PO requirement & temporary invoice path
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@starlite.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Onboarding: Starlite PO requirement & temporary invoice path

Hi Marta —

Thanks for the call this morning and for choosing Redwood for your trial. A couple of items to align on before we start provisioning access:

- Our default enterprise onboarding assumes a Purchase Order (PO) for invoiced customers.
- For short pilots we sometimes allow a temporary "invoice-only" lane (no PO) with guardrails: cap on spend, shortened payment terms, and a signed onboarding addendum.

Can you confirm whether Starlite can issue a PO for the initial pilot? If not, would you accept the invoice-only pilot approach? If invoice-only, we typically require:
- pilot cap (suggested $5,000)
- customer billing contact + billing address (for invoice)
- evidence of financial contact (bank or procurement contact)
- signed onboarding form (attached)

I attached the onboarding form to speed things up. If you prefer the PO route, include the PO contact and expected PO # timeline and we will route to procurement.

Next steps: once you confirm PO vs invoice-only I will coordinate a short approval with Finance (cc'd).

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Partnerships (sales ops liaison)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: starlite_onboarding_form.pdf
Related: https://hub.redwood.com/deals/DL-8472

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@starlite.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Vega <c.vega@starlite.ai>
Date: 2026-09-22T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: Starlite PO requirement & temporary invoice path

Hi Irene —

Thanks for the clear options. For the initial 30-day trial Starlite cannot commit a PO immediately — procurement is tied up with a quarter close. We can do invoice-only for the pilot and move to a formal PO if the pilot meets our internal check points.

We agree to the $5k cap. Billing contact is Carlos Vega (c.vega@starlite.ai). Billing address and W-9 attached in my reply (I will forward those in a separate email).

Can you confirm expected invoicing frequency and payment terms for the invoice-only pilot? We prefer Net 30. Also please confirm whether we need any additional paperwork to move to PO after the pilot.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Marta

—
Marta Ruiz
Head of Procurement
Starlite AI

Irene — thanks for looping us in. My thoughts:
- Risk tolerance is OK for a one-off invoice-only pilot at <$5k, provided we get the billing contact and signed onboarding addendum.
- Require a simple evidence checklist: billing contact + W-9, PO intent statement (Marta's note is fine), and a signed SLA/addendum that makes the pilot time-boxed and caps liability.
- Finance will accept Net 30 for customers with established billing contacts; for pilots we should mark account as "pilot-invoice" in ERP to avoid automatic PO enforcement.

Marissa — can you please prepare the onboarding addendum (short) and the SLA redline? I'll prep the risk note for Finance approval (small-dollar exception).

Karthik
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>

Thanks everyone —

Marissa: attaching a short addendum and a draft SLA for the trial. Marissa, can you shorten to one page and include: term (30 days), cap ($5,000), billing contact, Net 30 payment terms, and explicit statement that this is a temporary invoice-only pathway pending PO issuance?

Marta/Carlos: please sign the addendum and return scanned copy. Also upload W-9 and billing address to the Drive link below. Once signed, I will route to Finance with Karthik's small-dollar exception note. Expect a decision within 48 business hours after we submit.

Deliverables checklist:
- Signed onboarding addendum (attached)
